verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Edge0 models come as a single directory: a base checkpoint with a `config.json`, plus unmerged LoRA and prerouter adapters. The base stays read-only and is never merged, and it can run as a plain model via `--no-lora`/`--no-prerouter`. Loading uses transformers-style `AutoModel`/`AutoEngine` from a path, which hints at a standard layout that other tools could reuse. Nothing states that these files or caches work in other runtimes without re-downloading or converting, so the developer cannot actually know this from the docs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of on-disk weight format and quantization compatibility with other runtimes (e.g. Hugging Face transformers, llama.cpp, MLX), guidance on sharing caches with or importing from existing model stores, and any hands-on confirmation of cross-runtime reuse.
